hook: The 90-foot Hōlei Sea Arch vanished into the Pacific within four days.

sections.voiceover: The 90-foot Hōlei Sea Arch vanished into the Pacific within four days.

On September 23, 2026, the National Park Service reported this formation intact in Hawaiʻi Volcanoes National Park. Lava flows created this structure 550 years ago along the Big Island's coast. Where did the stone go?
Except the exact moment of its total collapse remains entirely unknown.
By September 27, 2026, the 27.4-meter-tall arch had fallen into the ocean. Nature reclaimed the landmark permanently. This geological feature is now gone from the southern coastline.
Only the 550-year-old lava foundation remains near the Pacific.
